_comment: RA-010 comes into the packet when the filer says they will appear remotely. Filed WITH the request it meets the deadline the form itself gives the party asking for a hearing on a protective order (page 3, item 4: 'With the moving papers or at least 5 court days before the hearing'), and item 2a, 'Throughout the case', needs no hearing date - which the filer cannot know at filing, because the court sets it on DV-109. What the filer supplies is the caption, items 1 to 5 and the signature on page 2; the caption carries the packet's names (person_asking_protection_*, person_to_restrain_full_name, court_street_address) so it is asked once, and item 1's Plaintiff/Petitioner box carries the answer that switches the form on (appear_remotely_yes), the way DV-105(A) box 1 carries DV-105's No. Three things are left blank by design and marked courtUse only because that is the flag that keeps a field out of the interview - none of them is the court's, and each says why in its _why: (1) the Declaration of Notice on page 2, which the filer signs under penalty of perjury after notice has been given; at filing it has not been, and the form lets a proof of service show it instead - the other side is told when this form is served on them with the rest of the papers; (2) item 1's Defendant/Respondent and their attorney, who give their own notice; (3) the caption's OTHER CASE NAME line, for a case that is not named by its parties. Page 3 is instructions and need not be filed. The six push buttons (print, save, clear, warning, two links) are type button and courtUse. The case number is courtUse as on every form in the packet.
